name: Revvity PhenoPlate 96 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Revvity PhenoPlate 96 well, black, optically clear flat bottom, tissue-culture treated, with lids. Formerly sold as PerkinElmer CellCarrier-96 Ultra. Dimensions from the dimensioned engineering drawing in Revvity Technical Data Sheet 0PD96Ph-24091, pages 2-3. Units in meters. Footprint 127.76 x 85.48 mm +/- 0.2, overall height 14.35 mm +/- 0.1, skirt height 2 mm, plate planarity 0.1 mm. Well spacing (pitch) 9 mm on both axes (the drawing dimensions x and y separately). A1 well center is 14.38 mm +/- 0.1 from the left edge and 11.24 mm +/- 0.1 from the top edge. Well top diameter 6.84 mm, bottom diameter 6.40 mm, flat bottom. Bottom is a 0.188 mm cyclic olefin film with refractive index 1.53, sitting 0.21 mm above the plate underside - Revvity's 'ultra-low plate bottom (200 um)' marketing figure refers to that bottom height, not the film thickness. Maximum volume 425 uL per well; working volume is not published. WELL DEPTH IS DERIVED, NOT PUBLISHED: the drawing gives only bracketed reference dimensions (13.1) and (12.7) from the underside datum, so depth is taken as 13.1 minus the 0.21 mm bottom height, about 12.89 mm. That is consistent with the stated 425 uL maximum. Revvity publishes no ANSI/SBS compliance statement, though the footprint, height and pitch all match the standard. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
